verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a Claude Code skill/plugin pack (installed via /plugin marketplace or copied into .claude/skills/). Plugins of this kind could plausibly bundle or consume MCP servers, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence mentions MCP. Any MCP-client ability would belong to the host platform (Claude Code), not this product, so it earns no credit. Its integrations (Google Calendar, Stripe) go through direct APIs, and its bundled scripts are standard-library Python that never touch the network.
